name: squiggly-text
title: Squiggly Text
description: Wraps any run of text in a live filter that keeps warping it, so a single word quivers and ruffles in place while the rest of the sentence stays crisp.
use: One playful word inside a headline should draw the eye without setting the whole sentence in motion.
avoid: Body copy or long text: constant turbulence hurts legibility and the filter costs work every frame.
a11y: The text stays real text and the filter SVG is hidden from assistive tech, but the wobble ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single line of bold white text on black. One word inside it has slightly ragged, doubled edges, while the words around it stay perfectly sharp.
behaves: The wrapped word is continuously displaced by a shifting noise filter that cycles through five shapes many times a second, so it shivers like a wobbly drawing. Nothing responds to input.
customise: Wrap the text as children and tune steps, stepDuration, scale, baseFrequency, numOctaves and the element type through props.
weight: moderate: An SVG displacement filter is reapplied to the word about twelve times a second.
demo: The sentence 'Make your text squiggly and fun', with the word squiggly animated.
issues: The distortion is slight, so on a still the word reads almost like plain text.
polishWhy: A tight, tidy filter trick; the wobble is so slight it can be missed at a glance.
